crossRefs.note: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set…
crossRefs.keyword: a hot burning. Heb. a burning of fire

translations.web: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,
translations.bsb: When there is a burn on someone’s skin and the raw area of the burn becomes reddish-white or white,
translations.kjv: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
translations.asv: Or when the flesh hath in the skin thereof a burning by fire, and the quick flesh of the burning become a bright spot, reddish-white, or white;
